description: Everyday DuckDB forms type with no unknown-function warning: mode of a column, regexp_extract of a group, regexp_replace with options, strftime with the format first, quantiles of a list of fractions, contains over a list or a map, range and generate_series called as values, which give lists, the JSON functions with a list of paths or an index, list_aggregate with an extra argument, isfinite of a timestamp and md5 of a blob
